events.factual_description: Red Bull Chapters makes its global debut with Rauw Alejandro at Forest Hills Stadium in Queens. Red Bull's official event guide describes the show as a three-act immersive live journey through Alejandro's past, present and future, combining live performance, storytelling, cultural influences and custom production while centering his Puerto Rican roots and artistic evolution. The current Bowery Presents and AXS listings show two performances, Saturday September 5 and Sunday September 6, 2026, both at 7:30 PM; Bowery lists doors at 5:30 PM for each date. en.why_it_matters: This is not just a stadium stop attached to a tour. Chapters is being launched around Alejandro's own musical biography: Puerto Rico, the move across reggaeton, R&B, electronic and pop languages, and a performance identity where choreography and visual construction are part of the music's meaning. Putting that story in Queens — a city he calls his second home — gives the format a real cultural axis rather than a generic retrospective frame.
en.trip_verdict: If New York is already in play this weekend, make room for one of the two Forest Hills nights. The second performance gives useful flexibility, so there is no reason to sacrifice a genuinely one-off regional date just to force this one into the itinerary.

es.why_it_matters: Esto no es simplemente otra parada de estadio pegada a una gira. Chapters se estrena alrededor de la propia biografía musical de Alejandro: Puerto Rico, el movimiento entre reggaetón, R&B, electrónica y pop, y una identidad escénica donde la coreografía y la construcción visual forman parte del sentido de la música. Llevar esa historia a Queens —en una ciudad que él llama su segundo hogar— le da al formato un eje cultural real y no el de una retrospectiva genérica.
es.trip_verdict: Si Nueva York ya está en juego este fin de semana, sí le haría espacio a una de las dos noches en Forest Hills. La segunda función da margen suficiente para acomodarla sin sacrificar por fuerza otro one-off verdaderamente irrepetible en el corredor.
